name: Laravel Check
on: [pull_request] # This triggers the check whenever someone opens a PR

jobs:
  laravel-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2' # Match your local version
          
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: composer install -q --no-ansi --no-interaction --no-scripts --no-progress --prefer-dist
        
      - name: Check for Syntax Errors
        run: php artisan test --parallel # This runs your Pest/PHPUnit tests
